verdict.rationale: Appwrite's own docs cover both halves of the story. Email/password login works "with just a few lines of code" using Argon2 hashing, and 30+ social OAuth providers (GitHub, Google, Apple, etc.) can be enabled from the Console. Access goes through its many SDKs or its REST/GraphQL APIs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that setup actually takes minutes, and SDK-level OAuth code examples in the evidence.
